topic: open source tool that renders html to video with claude
hook: This reel wasn't edited by a person. It was written as a web page.
caption:
Comment VIDEO and I'll DM you the link and my setup. Follow first so it reaches you.

This tool renders HTML as video. HeyGen open-sourced it. Claude writes the video as a web page, the tool renders all 900 frames at 30 fps, and you get a 1080x1920 MP4 for Instagram. It ships with about 450 ready-made blocks: captions, glitches, whip pans, 3D camera moves.

Free. Open source. Runs on a laptop.

#aitools #artificialintelligence #claudeai #codingtips #claudecode
